verdict.rationale: Mintlify's first-party docs describe an AI chat assistant added to the documentation site. It answers user questions, cites sources and links to relevant content, and it can also be embedded via the REST API. A community comment independently mentions Mintlify's AI assistant, but nothing hands-on tests how well its citations work. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of citation accuracy and answer quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an embedded AI assistant on my docs site answers reader questions with citations into my content

citations.quote: Add an AI-powered chat assistant to your documentation site that answers user questions, cites sources, and generates code examples on demand.
users can chat with the [assistant](/docs/assistant) in your documentation for immediate answers to their questions and links to relevant content
Use the Mintlify REST API to trigger deployments, embed an AI assistant
